title: Slice 1: command-contract conformance and .gitignore source discovery
description: DEC-216 (opum-doc, 2026-10-20), Q7 and its 'also fix' clause. Glyph must conform to the frozen Opum command contract (opum-doc docs/specs/opum-command-contract.md) before any consumer depends on its output: principal on both envelopes, the {error_type, message, principal} error shape, a dotted kind registry discoverable through glyph help --json, and the full exit-code family. Source discovery must honour .gitignore instead of a fixed directory list. Requested by opum-agent for ODOC-487, relayed 2026-10-20.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every successful `--json` result is exactly {schemaVersion, kind, data, principal}, with `principal: null` as the last top-level key; an envelope that omits the key fails the conformance test.

Every failure under `--json` writes {error_type, message, principal: null} to stderr with stdout empty; a classified failure and an uncaught crash share that shape, and `principal` is the last key in both.
Every command that supports `--json` emits a stable dotted `command.payload` kind, and the registry is machine-discoverable from live source rather than hand-listed.

`glyph help --json` emits kind `help.manifest`, whose data lists every command with its kind, flags and exit codes, plus the full exit-code taxonomy {ok: 0, uncaught: 1, usage: 2, not_found: 3, denied: 4, conflict: 5, validation: 6, drift: 6, indeterminate: 7}.

The full exit-code family is implemented and mapped per the frozen contract: 0 ok, 1 uncaught, 2 usage (including an ambiguous symbol), 3 not_found, 4 denied, 5 conflict, 6 validation/drift, 7 indeterminate.

A conformance test enumerates kinds and exit codes from live source, asserts exact equality with a golden set (non-vacuous), and is proven to fail for an empty golden map, a corrupted kind, a missing command and an out-of-family code.
Source discovery honours .gitignore, including nested .gitignore files, negation patterns and untracked non-ignored files; an ignored source never enters the index.

Tests cover a root ignore file, a nested ignore file, a negated pattern and an unignored untracked source; existing callers and diff answers are unchanged; `bun run check` passes; README states the contract and the discovery rule.

plan: 1. Establish the shared envelope, error shape and full exit-code taxonomy in src/errors.ts and a new src/contract.ts registry.
2. Convert every command to the dotted kind registry and add `glyph help --json` emitting help.manifest from live source.
3. Add the success/error envelope presence checks and the non-vacuous conformance test, proven against deliberate violations.
4. Replace the fixed-directory walk in src/discover.ts with .gitignore-honouring discovery and cover root, nested, negated and untracked cases.
5. Update README and tests, run bun run check, open the PR, and report head and checks before any land.
